ideas.pitch: An edge-computed acoustic sensor network placed near subway tracks to map train delays and mechanical wear through audio signature analysis.
ideas.title: SubwaySound: Real-Time Acoustic Transit Delay Mapping
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the winning hardware and acoustic mesh pattern from ICHack, offering a tangible, physical installation that judges can interact with live in New York City.

ideas.pitch: A low-latency edge-AI camera system that detects double-parked delivery trucks blocking NYC bike lanes and automatically logs municipal infractions.
ideas.title: GridLock: NYC Commercial Loading Zone Computer Vision Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets an intensely hyper-local New York City pain point that immediately resonates with local judges and city-dwellers.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first mesh network tracking real-time temperature and perishable inventory levels in mutual aid community fridges across upper Manhattan.
ideas.title: BoroughBite: Community Fridge Perishable Inventory Mesh
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the social impact angle combined with a working hardware dashboard, appealing directly to judges looking for tangible community utility.

ideas.pitch: A peer-to-peer WebRTC lecture streaming protocol optimized for congested university Wi-Fi networks during heavy midterms weeks.
ideas.title: CUNYClassroom: Low-Bandwidth Peer Lecture Streamer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an immediate, relatable campus-wide infrastructure issue for Columbia students experiencing poor network conditions.

ideas.pitch: An inertial measurement unit (IMU) sensor strapped to campus mail carts that crowdsources sidewalk bumpiness and stair obstructions in real-time.
ideas.title: PavementPulse: Campus Accessibility Routing for Wheelchairs
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines physical sensor data collection with a compelling accessibility use case, fulfilling the hardware-plus-live-demo winning formula.
